integrity: The proof decomposes both sample mean and sample range across the two ordered support cuts, evaluates the resulting four Bernoulli crossing covariances exactly, and reduces the sign question to one quadratic in the positive gap ratio. Exact-rational enumeration independently replays the identities.
scientific_limitations: The complete sign classification is for fixed three-point probability profiles.
The theorem concerns covariance and uncorrelatedness, not independence or the full correlation magnitude.
The exact indexed date used for the archive anchor is 2001-10-04; the journal issue itself is bibliographically labeled September 2000.
title: Exact sign phase diagram for sample-mean/sample-range covariance in three-point laws
